completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The pilot used excessive aft pitch control during rotation, which resulted in a higher-than-normal pitch attitude after liftoff and caused the airplane to exceed its critical angle of attack and enter an aerodynamic stall shortly after liftoff [20190811X63554:analysis][20190811X63554:factual]. About 15 seconds after liftoff the pilot felt the airplane shudder and begin to descend, and decreasing pitch did not stop the descent, so he made an immediate landing in a plant nursery about 0.5 mile from the departure end of the runway [20190811X63554:factual]. The pilot reported no mechanical malfunctions or failures that would have precluded normal operation [20190811X63554:analysis]."}
